verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm, but it ships client-facing legal-tech tools (the SCC and Term Sheet generators, Deal Room and other digital solutions), so asking about official SDKs is a fair question. The evidence never mentions any SDK, API or developer tooling. Probes found no llms.txt and returned 404 on every OpenAPI path checked, and the tools are presented only as questionnaires and hosted third-party platforms.
